time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); frame 0 at t = 0
pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin at top-left pixel; units px

camera.motion: static (uniform grey background RGB 206,206,206, corners constant all 72 frames; no texture to track, no pan possible to detect but none indicated)
camera.background: flat uniform light grey, no ground plane, horizon or vanishing points
camera.perspective_note: Declared 2D, but apparent sizes change slowly: left virus grows ~+0.22 px/frame in body radius (123.8 -> ~133.5 px over frames 1-48), right virus shrinks ~-0.16 px/frame (139.1 -> ~131 px over frames 1-44). Pixel step per frame changes in the same sense (left 11.5 -> ~12.9 px/frame, right 11.5 -> ~10.3 px/frame). Consistent with the left one moving slightly toward the camera and the right one slightly away (or a perspective camera viewing slightly off-plane motion). See notes.md.

objects.name: virus_left_small
objects.description: Spiky virus particle (coronavirus-like): dark blue-teal spherical body with ~40 dark-red-tipped spikes. The LEFT and slightly SMALLER of the two (at frame 0 body radius 123.8 px vs 139.1 px).
objects.motion: moves straight UP (and very slightly left, ~-0.4 px/frame in x) from frame 1 on, exits through the top edge; also rotates slowly
objects.reference_point: centre of the spherical body (circle fit to body outline) = object origin
objects.size_note: Full extent incl. spikes (proxy for world AABB) ~519x514 px at frame 0 growing to ~534x528 px at frame 27. Body (sphere without spikes) diameter 247.6 px at frame 0.

objects.name: virus_right_large
objects.description: Spiky virus particle identical in style: dark blue-teal body, dark-red-tipped spikes. The RIGHT and slightly LARGER of the two.
objects.motion: moves straight DOWN (and very slightly left, ~-0.4 px/frame in x) from frame 1 on, exits through the bottom edge; also rotates slowly
objects.reference_point: centre of the spherical body (circle fit to body outline) = object origin
objects.size_note: Full extent incl. spikes ~567x579 px at frame 0 shrinking to ~559x572 px at frame 13. Body diameter 278.2 px at frame 0.

pairwise.note: the two viruses' spike tips interleave around x~970-986 at frames 0-1 (near contact, not occluding each other's bodies); they separate vertically from frame 2

events.note: first displacement between frame 1 and 2; each moves ~11.5 px in frame 1->2, i.e. starts already at speed (no visible ramp-up)

events.event: left virus spikes reach top edge
left virus body touches top edge
right virus spikes reach bottom edge
right virus body touches bottom edge
